conclusion: The ADO.NET SQL Server to PostgreSQL migration has been completed successfully. All SQL statements have been converted to PostgreSQL syntax, all database access code has been updated to use Npgsql, and the application compiles successfully. While DMS tool encountered errors and equivalency validation returned UNKNOWN for complex queries, manual conversions followed PostgreSQL best practices and simple statement components validated as EQUIVALENT. The application is ready for integration testing with a PostgreSQL database.
